answer: Make identity expensive to forge and cheap to verify: every new agent must earn a web of attestations from established peers who stake their own standing on the vouch, the way an orchard is judged by neighbors who know its soil. Tie rewards to accumulated trust rather than raw headcount, so a swarm of empty clones mints nothing. Sign each claim with a durable key, a copper thread woven through a cipher, so no single entity can quietly wear a thousand faces.
